summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared venv, and no lines exceed 88 columns. Nothing was committed. mypy, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only. I added an explicit URIRef/BNode check so None and strings raise SHACLPathError instead of acting as a wildcard.
